head: bee155ab
headSubject: fix(runtimehost): plugin IPC JSON-safe check has no case for date/time concept fields (REG-249)
summary: Closed out two of the four Wave 8 WmsOffice residuals: WMS-14 (Recebimento's PreRecebimento->Enderecado transition now genuinely allocates LocalArmazenagemLote rows instead of a bare field flip, via a new EnderecarRecebimentoProcedure + AllocationCapability.enderecarRecebimento) and WMS-13 (retroactively ledgered the prior session's maxQuantity fix). Fixing WMS-14 surfaced and fixed a real platform bug, REG-249: the plugin process-isolation IPC layer had no JSON-safe handling for date-typed concept fields (java.sql.Date specifically), the same bug class REG-217 fixed for UUID but left open for dates -- fixed via a sanitize-to-ISO-8601-string approach after a JavaTimeModule attempt live-crashed the plugin child process with NoClassDefFoundError. WMS-15 (Expedicao's Confirmar Saida confirmation gap) and WMS-16 (item-level wizard sub-panels on Recebimento/Expedicao) were filed as OPEN and deliberately deferred -- both need a design decision, not a quick pickup.
nextStep: Pick WMS-15 or WMS-16 next (both OPEN, ledger/items/WMS-15.yml and WMS-16.yml). WMS-15 (Expedicao's Confirmar Saida has no second confirmation step) is smaller-scoped: decide whether to hand-author a confirmation page in front of ExpedicaoDemandaPanel's ConfirmarSaidaExpedicao flow (same pattern as web/reset-ambiente.html's type-to-confirm gate) or propose a real declarative confirmation-gate primitive in the panel-action schema (this is the second time that gap has been hit). WMS-16 (item-level wizard sub-panels -- Adicionar Itens selection, row clone, duplicate-product refusal, computed Total -- not declared on RecebimentoWorkbench or ExpedicaoWorkbench at all) is the largest-scoped residual; WMS-16's own detail suggests starting with Recebimento only and checking whether MovimentoLivrePanel's existing rowOps/addFormFields add-row pattern already covers the Adicionar Itens half before assuming new generator work is needed. Neither is blocked -- both are open design/scoping decisions for whoever picks them up.
plan: D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\AppGen\apps\_official\WmsOffice\definition\parity.json (updated this session to point at WMS-13..16 instead of stale prose); cross-referenced against ledger/items/WMS-13.yml, WMS-14.yml, WMS-15.yml, WMS-16.yml, REG-249.yml
blocked: None. WMS-15/WMS-16 need a design/scoping decision before implementation, not a blocker -- see NextStep.
verified: Live REST verification against wmsoffice-browser (fresh H2 DB, port 8100): POST .../Recebimento/invoke/EnderecarRecebimentoProcedure returns HTTP 200 with estagio=Enderecado, and a follow-up GET /api/local_armazenagem_lotes confirmed 37 real rows (quantidade summing to 37) with their LocalArmazenagem marked Ocupado. npdev validate model on the composed WmsOffice model: 0 errors, 58 pre-existing ux-metadata warnings (unchanged baseline). Narrow gradle test (com.finalexec.npdev.service.pluginipc.PluginIpcJsonSafeValuesTest, runtimehost-core) green after each of 3 source-change iterations. Full gradlew -p NPDevRuntimeHost/runtimehost-core test (all tests, not filtered) green. Full run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 run: this session's own code showed NO coverage regression (NPDevRuntimeHost floor RAISED 23.6484pct to 25.1044pct, a real improvement, not chased); the gate's overall exit was non-zero only from an unrelated, pre-existing NPDevCli coverage drop (60.2606pct to 60.085pct) that this session's diff never touched -- confirmed via git status showing zero NPDevCli files changed.
